scope: Two overworld monsters; released method bytes, pinned source, spawn/loot resources and independent predicate arithmetic. Not executed game code or measured damage.
limits: Biome structure tags are biome selectors, not a requirement to stand beside an actual structure
Spawn weight is not an encounter percentage; difficulty-scaled and other predicates still apply
Day phase is the source float predicate, not a wall-clock or fixed tick schedule
Projectile damage attribute2 is not the configured explosion entityDamage8
Explosion inputs are not measured final damage, safe distance or blocks destroyed
External explosion platform, permissions and mod hooks require target-build tests
